The released music video is a work that depicts the movements of the protagonist's mind, which stands still in the midst of his carefree days. As you move along, guided by a mysterious being that suddenly appears in front of you, you will find a magnificent landscape spreading out before you. ``The days don't go as planned, but if you go outside, you might find something.'' ``The scenery in front of you and the environment around you won't change easily, but if you have music that encourages you, you can take a step forward.'' articles.translatedTitle: mol-74 Kazuki Takeichi's solo project Alt Quark releases first MV "Tsuki no Oi"
articles.translatedExcerpt: Alt Quark, the solo project of mol-74 vocalist Kazuki Takeichi, has released the music video for "Tsuki no Oi", which was digitally released on November 18, 2026. This is Alt Quark's first music video. The MV is set in a coin laundry at night. The film is a quiet, cinematic film that carefully captures everyday fragments of everyday life, centering on a story about the memory of smells. The tranquil and unpretentious world view of the song, created by piano accompaniment, and the natural atmosphere of the video harmonize beautifully. The director was Yutaka Tsunemaji, who is active in a wide range of fields including movies, dramas, and music videos. His directorial work ``Kono Hibi ga Calm'' was officially invited to the 45th Moscow International Film Festival, and he has also worked on music videos for many artists such as Hitsuji Bungaku, Uru, and Ikimonogakari.

articles.translatedExcerpt: Starting today, his birthday, YOSHIKI will hold a charity auction to provide additional support to areas affected by heavy rains and typhoons in his hometown of Chiba Prefecture. Up for sale is a set of 6 not-for-sale glasses with YOSHIKI's autograph, co-produced by YOSHIKI's Paris-based fashion brand MAISON YOSHIKI PARIS and the French crystal brand Baccarat. The entire amount of the winning bid will be donated to Chiba Prefecture's disaster relief fund through YOSHIKI FOUNDATION AMERICA, an American non-profit public interest corporation. YOSHIKI is donating 10 million yen to Chiba Prefecture through the foundation in response to the heavy rain disaster in August 2026. In 2019, we also donated 1,000 to the Japanese Red Cross Society to support Chiba Prefecture, which was affected by Typhoon No. 15.

The choreography of him lying on the floor overlaps with the figure of him lying listlessly in the room, and the choreography also blends into the scene where he faces his reflection in the mirror and expresses his anger. The album title ``MCFDN'' comes from their previous band, ``the McFaddin.'' the McFaddin was formed mainly by members who met in Osaka. articles.translatedTitle: Rapid Tokyo releases new SG “Ira”
articles.translatedExcerpt: Kaisoku Tokyo is a rock band with each song lasting just one minute, perfect for those of you who are busy. The new single "Futsu", which was released for the first time in about eight years, contains three rock songs with outstanding sharpness: "Iraira", "Hitori", and "Metal Man 5". The title song "Iraza" is a short tune that, as the title suggests, uses the emotion of "irritation" as its engine. ``The power of irritation'' and ``stress is power'' and the thrill of not just canceling out frustration and stress, but turning it into the strength to move forward is unique to Rapid Tokyo. The phrases ``Sore-ish'' and ``That-like'' are played on like a play on words, and seem to be an ironic take on the current world, which is full of borrowed words and ``uniqueness.'' In the end, the song asks what it means to be a ``me-ish me'' and packs laughter, criticism, and impulse into 79 seconds. “Hitori” is the shortest song on the list at 69 seconds. …

articles.translatedTitle: Yuta Orisaka's 5th winter-themed album "Totama" will be released on December 9th, "Watayuki" will be released in advance and a tour will be held in 6 cities nationwide
articles.translatedExcerpt: Singer-songwriter Yuta Orisaka will release his fifth full-length album, "Fuyuutama," on Wednesday, December 9, 2026, approximately two and a half years after his previous album, "Shoujo." For Orisaka, who announced her independence from her agency at the end of October this year, this is the first work to mark a new start. This is the first album release in about 10 years since ``Tamuke'' from the label ``Noroshi Records'', which he founded with Fumi Matsui and Hajime Yaku in the early days of his career. This work is a concept album with a total of 10 songs created with the theme of "winter". This work depicts multifaceted moods and emotions, including songs that color the seasons such as the Christmas song "Watayuki," "Yuzu," which depicts the calm and warmth of New Year's Eve, and "Kusudama," which evokes the light of the new year, as well as "Fuyuugare," which reflects the harsh winter scenery, and labelmate Aya Matsui's song "NOT MY DAY."

articles.excerpt: Ari Abdulが2026年11月13日(金)にニューアルバム『THE VOID』をリリースした。 全12曲を収録した本作は、彼女がこれまで築き上げてきたダークで官能的なオルタナティブポップの世界をさらに深化させた作品。孤独、愛への執着、自己肯定感の揺らぎ、そして自分自身を見失っていく感覚など、人間の内面に潜む複雑な感情を、妖しくも中毒性の高いサウンドに落とし込んでいる。 2022年のデビューシングル「BABYDOLL」で注目を集めて以来、独自の美学とミステリアスな音楽性でファンを獲得してきたAri Abdul。本作は、彼女のアーティストとしての成長と、これまで以上にパーソナルな表現への挑戦を刻んだ重要な1枚となっている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/444…
articles.translatedTitle: Ari Abdul, dark and sensual new AL release
articles.translatedExcerpt: Ari Abdul released his new album ``THE VOID'' on Friday, November 13, 2026. This work, which includes a total of 12 songs, further deepens the dark and sensual alternative pop world that she has built so far. He captures the complex emotions hidden within humans, such as loneliness, attachment to love, a wavering sense of self-esteem, and the feeling of losing oneself, into a mysterious yet highly addictive sound. Since gaining attention with his debut single "BABYDOLL" in 2022, Ari Abdul has been gaining fans with his unique aesthetic and mysterious musicality. This work is an important record that marks her growth as an artist and her challenge to create a more personal expression than ever before. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/444…

articles.translatedTitle: Gang of Youths releases disturbing new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Gang of Youths released their new single "Benny's Video" on Thursday, November 12, 2026. This work is the second single from the 4th album "Compañero" scheduled to be released next March. This is the follow-up to "Things Take Time" released in August of this year, and it is a song that gives the impression that the band has stepped into a new creative phase. The biggest feature of this song is the dynamic synthesizer and the musical contrast that gives off a somewhat ominous feeling. The 1992 film Benny's Video was a source of inspiration for the song, and the film's disturbing atmosphere and themes surrounding human psychology and violence are reflected in the song's dark worldview. At that time, God whispered to me... "There's a Squier JAZZMASTER body in the closet... There's also an Ibanez 7-string that I bought but don't really like... You know what else?" I used to mess around with junk guitars and cheap guitars, so I had some know-how, but this was my first time converting a 6-string body to a 7-string body.

New participants announced include Yasuhiro Suzuki, Keizo Nakanishi, and Baby Boo. He met Yasuhiro Suzuki when he appeared on the radio to promote his previous work, and ended up singing Kozo Murashita's famous song "Yuko." With Keizo Nakanishi, who co-starred in the previous work, Yasushi Nakanishi vowed that ``only these two would sing together,'' and the song ``Nishiki no Uta'', which has been loved by fans for many years, will be included on the CD for the first time. Baby Boo will sing Billy Joel's famous song ``The Longest Time,'' which Yasushi Nakanishi said he sang with his friends on the banks of the Kamogawa River in Kyoto during his youth. articles.translatedTitle: YOASOBI will hold their first Korean stadium live performance at the <Super Planet> tour final
articles.translatedExcerpt: It has been decided that YOASOBI will hold their first stadium performance in South Korea on Saturday, April 17, 2027 at Goyang Stadium (Goyang General Sports Complex) in Goyang City, South Korea, as the final of their currently ongoing tour <YOASOBI 11-CITY ASIA-OCEANIA TOUR 2026-2027 “Super Planet”>. This will be the group's third solo performance in South Korea, the first time in about 2 years and 4 months since their arena performance in Incheon in December 2024. Last time, all seats were sold out in just one minute after ticket reservations started, making it a hot topic in Korea due to its high popularity. This time, the stage will be moved to the stadium and the finale of "Super Planet" will be displayed. The overseas performances will start with the TAIPEI DOME performance in Taipei on Saturday, January 9th and Sunday, January 10th, 2027, followed by ASI in Hong Kong on Thursday, January 21st, and Friday, January 22nd, 2027.

articles.translatedTitle: Avery Anna releases emotional new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Avery Anna released her new single "Roadkill" on Friday, November 13, 2026. This is an ambitious work that combines the storytelling of country music with the wild energy of alternative rock. They are presenting a new musical direction, expanding their range of expression from their previous delicate country sound and bringing distorted guitars and powerful vocals to the forefront. The theme of the song is about someone who reaches out to you when you are at the lowest point in your life, and how through that love you can regain the strength to live again. Through the impressive title ``Roadkill,'' which refers to someone left behind on the side of the road, it depicts the preciousness of being saved by someone. articles.translatedExcerpt: Noah Rinker released his new single "Kids" on Friday, November 13, 2026. With a folk-based acoustic sound in the background, this work depicts the innocence of youth, the joy of falling in love with someone for the first time, and the pure emotions that are lost over time. This work stands out for Noah Rinker's unique unpretentious singing voice and songwriting that sublimates personal experiences into universal stories. The central theme of this song is the innocence that passes with youth, and the special glow that young love has. It is a song that makes you feel the preciousness of time that has passed while looking back on the joys and pains of your youth. articles.excerpt: Alec Benjaminが2026年11月13日(金)にニューシングル「Without My Strings」をリリースした。 本作は、他者からの期待や、自分自身で作り上げてしまった限界、そして人生を思い通りに生きられなくさせる様々な状況から抜け出し、自分自身の人生の主導権を取り戻すことをテーマにした楽曲。感情豊かなボーカルと、内省的なメッセージが融合した、希望と解放を感じさせるポップナンバーに仕上がっている。 本楽曲のプロデュースには、Sacha Skarbek、Stephen Barnes、Yarden“JORDi”Pelegが参加。アコースティックな温もりとピアノ、ストリングスによる豊かな音楽的広がりが、楽曲の持つ解放感と感情の起伏を引き立てている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.j…
articles.translatedTitle: Alec Benjamin releases introspective new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Alec Benjamin released his new single "Without My Strings" on Friday, November 13, 2026. This song is about getting rid of the expectations of others, the limits you have created for yourself, and the various situations that prevent you from living your life the way you want, and regaining control of your own life. The song is a pop number that combines emotional vocals and an introspective message, giving a feeling of hope and liberation. This song was produced by Sacha Skarbek, Stephen Barnes, and Yarden “JORDi” Peleg. The rich musical expanse of the acoustic warmth, piano, and strings brings out the sense of freedom and emotional ups and downs of the song. Release information https://ototoy.j…

articles.title: Amira Elfeky、夢と現実が交差する新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Amira Elfekyが2026年11月13日(金)にニューアルバム『It was only a dream』をリリースした。 本作は、2025年発表のEP『Surrender』に続く作品であり、彼女にとって初のフルアルバム。これまで培ってきた重厚なオルタナティブロックやニューメタルのサウンドを基盤に、ポップやエレクトロニックの要素を大胆に取り入れ、アーティストとしての新たな表現領域を切り拓く意欲作となっている。 本作の中心にあるテーマは、理想の自分と現実の自分との間に存在するギャップ、そして自己解放への渇望。夢の中にいる自分と現実を生きる自分が衝突し、やがて一つになっていくというコンセプトが、音楽とアートワークの両面から表現されている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/defau…
articles.translatedTitle: Amira Elfeky, new AL release where dreams and reality intersect
articles.translatedExcerpt: Amira Elfeky released her new album "It was only a dream" on Friday, November 13, 2026. This work is the follow-up to the EP "Surrender" released in 2025, and is her first full-length album. Based on the solid alternative rock and nu metal sounds that he has cultivated up until now, this album boldly incorporates pop and electronic elements, creating an ambitious work that opens up a new realm of expression for him as an artist. The central theme of this work is the gap between the ideal self and the real self, and the longing for self-liberation. The concept of the self in a dream and the self living in reality colliding and eventually becoming one is expressed through both music and artwork. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/defau…

articles.title: Emma Ogier、全12曲を収録した新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Emma Ogierが2026年11月11日(水)にニューアルバム『Fly 1111』をリリースした。 本作には、音楽とともに生きることの喜びや犠牲、将来への迷い、そして不確かな状況の中でも自分自身を信じることの大切さを描いた全12曲を収録。プロデューサーにDavid Baronを迎え、彼女の豊かな創造性と飾らない人間性を凝縮した作品に仕上がっている。 本作の中心にあるテーマは、クリエイティブな人生を選択することに伴う犠牲と葛藤、そして自分の直感を信じること。恋愛の高揚感や人間関係の複雑さ、成長することへの戸惑いなど、誰もが経験し得る感情を率直な言葉で表現している。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4421376 アーティスト情報 https://www.inst…
articles.translatedTitle: Emma Ogier releases new AL with 12 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: Emma Ogier released her new album ``Fly 1111'' on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. This work includes a total of 12 songs that depict the joy and sacrifice of living with music, doubts about the future, and the importance of believing in yourself even in uncertain situations. With David Baron as the producer, the result is a work that condenses her rich creativity and simple humanity. The film's central themes are the sacrifices and conflicts that come with choosing a creative life, and trusting one's intuition. It uses frank words to express emotions that anyone can experience, such as the exhilaration of love, the complexity of human relationships, and the confusion of growing up. articles.translatedTitle: Beach Bunny releases new song about anger against commercialism
articles.translatedExcerpt: Beach Bunny released their new single "Vinegar" on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. This work explores the themes of dissatisfaction and anger towards the mass consumerism, commercialism, and corporate profit-prioritization that pervades modern society. It is an energetic fuzz pop number. This song is a fusion of catchy power pop and distorted guitar sound. More than just a critique of society, they sublimate the discomfort and suffocation felt in daily life into rock anthems that anyone can sing aloud. articles.translatedExcerpt: Becky Hill released her new album "REBECCA" on Friday, November 13, 2026. This work combines dance, drum and bass, and electronic music with guitar sounds and alternative elements. It is an energetic and emotional work that gives you a sense of her new musical evolution. articles.translatedTitle: [Interview] Is this a miracle or is it natural? The mysterious "violin guitar"
articles.translatedExcerpt: In 2026, the season for TC Musical Instruments' famous "Modified Guitar Contest" has arrived. This event, which is held every year in alternation with the "Modified Effector Contest," is in its 6th year. The number of applicants has been increasing year by year, and this year's collection was the largest ever. Although it has a simple name, ``Modified Guitar Contest,'' the rules are loosely based on the concept that ``having fun is the most important thing,'' and it is one of the events that has become a tradition in the musical instrument industry, with everyone from the creators and judges to the guitar enthusiasts who see these works laughing, surprised, admiring, complimenting them by saying ``You're stupid,'' and giving them the utmost respect by saying ``You're crazy.'' Many of the guitars submitted this time were rare and rare pieces, and it was hard to tell whether they were a joke or a joke, or whether they were being taken for granted. If you think it's a joke, it actually makes sense...

articles.title: Mack Geiger、カントリーな新ALリリース
articles.excerpt: Mack Geigerが2026年11月6日(金)にニューアルバム『Dying In This House』をリリースした。 本作は伝統的なカントリーミュージックの豊かなサウンドと、人生の機微をすくい取る等身大のストーリーテリングが融合した作品。失恋、孤独、後悔、家族への愛情、そして困難の先に見いだす希望まで、人間の複雑な感情を丁寧に描き出している。 アルバムの中心にあるのは、ひとりの男が孤独や失恋、否認と向き合いながら、少しずつ自分自身を取り戻していく物語。プロデュースには、ナッシュビルのベテランプロデューサー・Keith StegallとJared Adlamを迎え、作品全体に一貫した音楽的な世界観を構築している。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/441226…
articles.translatedTitle: Mack Geiger releases new country AL
articles.translatedExcerpt: Mack Geiger released his new album ``Dying In This House'' on Friday, November 6, 2026. This work combines the rich sounds of traditional country music with life-sized storytelling that captures the subtleties of life. It carefully depicts the complex human emotions such as heartbreak, loneliness, regret, love for family, and even the hope found beyond hardship. At the heart of the album is the story of a man gradually regaining himself while dealing with loneliness, heartbreak, and denial. Produced by veteran Nashville producers Keith Stegall and Jared Adlam, they create a consistent musical worldview throughout the album. Release information https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/441226…

The music video for "Destiny Search" was directed by filmmaker Ayaka Masuda and starred Shuhei Nomura and Yui Narumi. A man and a woman meet by chance on a ferry, and the glances, expressions, and casual gestures they exchange on the boat are depicted, and the sense of distance between the two, who gradually become attracted to each other, is delicately expressed. It is a finished product that carefully depicts the worldview of "Fate Search". The making video released this time includes not only the actual shooting scenery and the scene, but also an interview with Hattori (Vo) about the song production. In the new corner, ``Listen to Mr. Tsurube,'' Aoyama's unique grandmother, who has watched over him since he was a child, appears.
